mapper.insert: insert into marketing_referral_credential (public_id, sharer_member_id, campaign_key, target_type, target_id, issued_at, expires_at, status, token_hash, create_time) values (#{publicId}, #{sharerMemberId}, #{campaignKey}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{tokenHash}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, public_id as publicId, sharer_member_id as sharerMemberId, campaign_key as campaignKey, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, issued_at as issuedAt, expires_at as expiresAt, status, token_hash as tokenHash, create_time as createTime from marketing_referral_credential where public_id = #{publicId}
